sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Bears are aggressive creatures found in the Black Forest. They are bulky, furry beasts with large claws and teeth.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Bears will avoid fire, they will run away if they get within 3 meters of a fire source. A bear will run away from a player who is holding a Torch and facing the bear, i.e., the bear is within a 90 degree arc of the front of the player. They will attack players from either side or the back, but if the player turns to face the bear fast enough, then the bear will alter the attack direction at the last moment, making the attack miss.
Bears consume Blueberries on the ground, but they are not tameable. They do not attack Viles despite being in two enemy factions.

sections.heading: Bite
sections.text: Lunges forward to bite the player (55 Pierce damage). This extends 4 meters in a 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used every 4 seconds when within 3 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Claws
sections.text: Stands on their hind legs, bounces forward a little, and slams down to attack (50 Slash and 40 Tier 0 Chop damage). This attack has an arched hitbox 5.5 meters long and 45 degrees across horizontally. It can be used every 4 seconds when within 5 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Swipe
sections.text: This attack has three variations, each with its own 4-second cooldown: a swipe with the left claw, a swipe with the right claw, and both swipes chained together (25 Slash and 40 Tier 0 Chop damage each hit). This attack extends 5.5 meters out in a 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used within 5 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Slam
sections.text: Looks very similar to the claw attack, but remains stationary instead of bouncing forward and puts slightly more emphasis on their paws instead of claws (50 Blunt, 40 Tier 0 Chop and 40 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). Unlike the claw attack, this attack hits in a circular area with a radius of 2.5 meters. This can be used every 12 seconds when within 5 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text:
• All Bear's attacks have tool tier 0, which mean they can not be used to harvest resources that require equipment.
• Bears and Viles regenerate slightly faster than most creatures, recovering full health over 50 minutes instead of 60.

Introduction. Bears are aggressive creatures found in the Black Forest. They are bulky, furry beasts with large claws and teeth.

Behavior. Bears will avoid fire, they will run away if they get within 3 meters of a fire source. A bear will run away from a player who is holding a Torch and facing the bear, i.e., the bear is within a 90 degree arc of the front of the player. They will attack players from either side or the back, but if the player turns to face the bear fast enough, then the bear will alter the attack direction at the last moment, making the attack miss.
Bears consume Blueberries on the ground, but they are not tameable. They do not attack Viles despite being in two enemy factions.

Bite. Lunges forward to bite the player (55 Pierce damage). This extends 4 meters in a 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used every 4 seconds when within 3 meters of a player.

Claws. Stands on their hind legs, bounces forward a little, and slams down to attack (50 Slash and 40 Tier 0 Chop damage). This attack has an arched hitbox 5.5 meters long and 45 degrees across horizontally. It can be used every 4 seconds when within 5 meters of a player.

Swipe. This attack has three variations, each with its own 4-second cooldown: a swipe with the left claw, a swipe with the right claw, and both swipes chained together (25 Slash and 40 Tier 0 Chop damage each hit). This attack extends 5.5 meters out in a 45-degree horizontal arc and can be used within 5 meters of a player.

Slam. Looks very similar to the claw attack, but remains stationary instead of bouncing forward and puts slightly more emphasis on their paws instead of claws (50 Blunt, 40 Tier 0 Chop and 40 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). Unlike the claw attack, this attack hits in a circular area with a radius of 2.5 meters. This can be used every 12 seconds when within 5 meters of a player.

Note. • All Bear's attacks have tool tier 0, which mean they can not be used to harvest resources that require equipment.
• Bears and Viles regenerate slightly faster than most creatures, recovering full health over 50 minutes instead of 60.
